high_level_description: The image features a man seated in an office chair, dressed in formal attire consisting of a white shirt and a maroon vest with buttons. He is wearing glasses and has a mustache. The background includes a bookshelf filled with books, suggesting an intellectual or academic setting. There is also a framed picture on the wall behind him. The text overlay on the image reads: "Although born into humble beginnings, A. Velumani's journey from utter poverty to prosperity, is, in many ways, a story of an unyielding work ethic." This text is attributed to Arnav Das Sharma, dated April 18,
